assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Import Map fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And the controlled creation clock returns 1700000000000 milliseconds

steps.title: Set fixed time "Wed Nov 15 2023 06:13:20 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 4. And the baseline fixture data defines "Module Name" as "container-001"
5. And the baseline fixture data defines "Path" as "https://fixture.example/case-001.js"
6. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Create New Import Map" on the Import Map administration page
7. Then the dialog titled "new ID: 1700000000000" is visible on the Import Map administration page
8. When Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Module Name" with "" in dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
9. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Path" with "https://fixture.example/case-001.js" in dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
10. And Admin A clicks the button labeled "Create" in dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
11. Then the dialog titled "new ID: 1700000000000" remains visible on the Import Map administration page
12. And the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar contains the exact text "Please provide the value for the Module Name or Path."
